title: Latency cohort board: model & route breakdown by request shape and streaming heuristics
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build a dashboard (cohort board) that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency split by model + route, with additional faceting by request shape (prompt tokens, completion length, system vs assistant priming), streaming vs non-streaming IO mode, and our streaming heuristics (prefill, chunk-size, early_flush). Motivation: Ops and SRE teams need to quickly identify which request cohorts drive tail latency regressions and whether streaming optimizations are effective for given shapes. This board will also link to traces and to the rollouts console so PMs/Eng can correlate recent deploys to observed changes.
acceptance_criteria: Board shows p50/p95/p99 for any model+route combination and allows selecting time window and percentile
Cohort filters include: prompt_token_count (buckets), expected_completion_tokens (buckets), streaming_mode (streaming|sync), streaming_heuristic (prefill|standard|early_flush), kernel_variant
Each cohort row includes: sample_size, error_rate, avg_kv_cache_hit_ratio, trace_link_preview (sampled trace id), and 95th-percentile compute vs network split if available
Click-through from a cohort opens a trace search pre-filtered to that cohort and time-range
Dashboard loads in <6s for 1h window and in <12s for 24h window for org-wide queries
Baseline alert rule: if p95 for any model+route+cohort increases >25% vs rolling 7d baseline, create an insight and page the oncall owner per SLO policy
data_sources: clickhouse: raw latency events with tags (model, route, io_mode, heuristic, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, kv_cache_hit_ratio, kernel_variant)
tempo/jaeger: sampled traces (span timings, first_byte, last_byte, upstream_queue)
metrics: per-route error counters and compute GPU milliseconds
logs: device-level kernel warnings and quantization fallbacks
proposed_queries: ClickHouse (example): SELECT model, route, io_mode, heuristic, bucket(prompt_token_count, 0,32,64,128,256,512) AS prompt_bucket, quantileExact(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantileExact(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, quantileExact(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99, count() AS sample_size FROM latency_events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY model, route, io_mode, heuristic, prompt_bucket ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 500
Trace-link generation: concat('https://tempo.internal/trace/', anyHeavy(trace_id)) where sampled = 1
Compute/network split (if dual-timers present): SELECT quantileExact(0.95)(compute_ms) AS compute_p95, quantileExact(0.95)(network_ms) AS network_p95 FROM latency_events WHERE <cohort_filters>
Error rate: SELECT countIf(success=0)/count() FROM latency_events WHERE <cohort_filters> AND ts >= now()-INTERVAL 1H
tasks: Add new cohort tags to latency_events pipeline: ensure heuristic and prompt_token_count buckets are emitted at ingestion (ENG infra)
ClickHouse materialized view for pre-aggregates by model/route/io_mode/heuristic/prompt_bucket
Grafana (or internal console) panel implementation with interactive cohort filters and trace links
Trace sampling adjustment: increase sampling for high-p95 cohorts for 48h baseline collection
QA: validate values against raw traces for 100 random sampled requests
Alert rule authoring and runbook link for paging scenarios

notes: Implementation choice: use pre-aggregated MV to keep dashboard interactive; raw quantiles are expensive across high-cardinality dims.
Trade-offs: bucketizing prompt_token_count trades precision for performance — chosen buckets reflect common percentiles observed in production.
Follow-ups: add a 'compare cohorts' mode to visualize delta p95 between two time ranges and anchor to rollout IDs.
